ITEM.PTXT: A stainless steel exhaust manifold with an integrated three-way catalytic converter has been adopted. Placing the catalyst directly below the engine improves catalyst warm-up, improving emission performance immediately after engine start. In addition, adopting an A/F sensor enables precise air-fuel ratio control, complying with the "Arial 17 Emission Regulations" and achieving the "Arial 17 Standard Emissions 75% Reduction Level (SU-LEV)".
